params.message:
Compare archived sheets without depending on Chrome's node numbers

ArchivingAReportTest renders one report twice, through the controller and
through the archive, and compares the PDFs without what may differ between
two renders. Chrome's PDF writer (Skia) numbers every element of the
structure tree, (node00000093), and those numbers need not start at the same
place in two renders. The test took the number out after /ID only, not where
the same number comes back: in the /Headers of a table cell and in the tree's
/Names and /Limits. On 2026-10-26 PR #275, which changed no report, went red
on exactly that: the two sheets were the same apart from every node number
being one higher in the second.

The node numbers are now renumbered in the order they appear instead of
removed, so two renders that count from a different start compare equal,
while a cell that points at another header still fails. The comment named
dompdf; the sheet comes from Chrome (/Producer (Skia/PDF m156)).

Checked on a real sheet from the test: shifted by one, the old comparison
fails and the new one passes; with one cell pointing at the next header, the
new one still fails.
